changes.before: An idealised control selected determinants using exact parent probabilities, without shots or an ADAPT circuit.
changes.after: An idealised control selected determinants using exact parent probabilities, without shots or an ADAPT circuit. Here field-only means selection of the top \(R\) determinants by exact parent ground-state probability at full MM-charge scaling, \(s=1\). For the ideal pooled space, the candidates are the union of the top-\(R\) lists at vacuum, half field and full field, \(s=0,1/2,1\); the \(R\) largest equal-weight sums of the three exact probabilities are retained, with increasing determinant index breaking ties. The field scales the inherited MM charges in the same fixed vacuum-orbital parent CAS. This deterministic probability rule is distinct from the finite-shot frequency-pooling construction below.

include.purpose: Complete retained ideal-control implementation: field scaling, exact probabilities, top-R union/ranking/ties and common fixed-orbital model. No execution or new results.
